entities.name: ESM DUMMY MESSAGE
entities.description: A message sent by the UE or the network included in an ESM message container information element during an attach procedure, used when the UE does not request for PDN connection.

entities.name: ESM message container
entities.description: An information element that contains ESM messages such as the ESM dummy message during attach procedures.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: The procedure during which the ESM dummy message may be sent when no PDN connection is requested.

entities.name: UE does not request PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where the UE does not request a PDN connection during the attach procedure, triggering the use of the ESM dummy message.

relations.description: The ESM message container information element contains the ESM dummy message.
The attach procedure includes sending the ESM dummy message when no PDN connection is requested.
The condition that the UE does not request a PDN connection determines the use of the ESM dummy message.
